in_arabic.name: قاسمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Qasimah' (قاسمة), which means 'divided' or 'separated' in the context of war or battle. It is also used as a female given name.

in_urdu.name: قاسمہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: قاسمہ (Qasimah) is a name derived from the Arabic word 'Qasimah' (قاسمة), which means 'divided' or 'separated' in the context of war or battle. In Urdu, it is pronounced as 'مقسومہ' (Maqsoomah) and translates to 'the divided one' or 'the separated one'.

in_hindi.name: कासीमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: कासीमा (Kasimā) is a name derived from the Arabic word 'Qasimah' (قاسمة), which means 'divided' or 'separated' in the context of war or battle. In Hindi, it is pronounced as 'विघटिता' (Vighaṭitā) and translates to 'the divided one' or 'the separated one'.

in_pashto.name: کاسمه
in_pashto.long_meaning: کاسمه (Kasme) is a name derived from the Arabic word 'Qasimah' (قاسمة), which means 'divided' or 'separated' in the context of war or battle. In Pashto, it is pronounced as 'خودکش' (Khadkash) and translates to 'self-controlled' or 'strong-willed'.
